project: Automatos AI Platform — Security Hardening v2
description: PRD-44 v2: Security Hardening & Remediation (Updated Feb 2026). Full security re-audit found 12 of original 45 stories already completed (auth defaults, rate limiting, CORS, security headers, webhook verification, workspace membership, MIME validation, swagger disabled, browser API key removed, auto-admin removed). This v2 PRD contains only the REMAINING work plus NEW findings: unauthenticated generated-images endpoint, broken admin role checks in admin_prompts and system_settings, 8 error-response leaks, outdated deps (fastapi 0.104.1), audit service stub, dev Docker running as root. 4 phases: (1) Critical auth/authz fixes, (2) Error sanitization and dependency updates, (3) Infrastructure hardening, (4) Code quality remediation.

userStories.title: Add authentication to generated_images endpoint
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the GET /api/generated-images/{image_id} endpoint protected with authentication. Currently it has ZERO auth — anyone knowing/guessing a UUID can access generated images.
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_request_context_hybrid dependency to the get_generated_image endpoint in orchestrator/api/generated_images.py
Unauthenticated requests receive 401 Unauthorized
Authenticated requests can still fetch images normally
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix admin_prompts _assert_admin to actually check admin role
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the _assert_admin function in admin_prompts.py to actually verify admin role instead of allowing any authenticated user. Currently lines 49-55 return immediately for ANY clerk or api_key auth type, bypassing role checks entirely.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify _assert_admin in orchestrator/api/admin_prompts.py to check ctx.user.system_role == 'admin' for Clerk auth
API key auth continues to pass (service-to-service trust)
Non-admin Clerk users receive 403 Forbidden
Admin Clerk users can still manage prompts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add admin role check to system_settings endpoints
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need system-settings CRUD endpoints restricted to admin users. Currently any authenticated user can read, create, update, and delete platform-wide system settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Add admin role verification to all mutation endpoints (POST, PUT, DELETE) in orchestrator/api/system_settings.py
GET endpoints remain accessible to any authenticated user (read-only is acceptable)
Non-admin users receive 403 Forbidden on mutation attempts
Admin users can still manage settings
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Lock down credential resolve endpoint to admin-only
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the credential resolve endpoint restricted to admin-only access so that decrypted secrets cannot be accessed by regular users.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/credentials/resolve requires authenticated admin role
GET /api/credentials/{credential_id} that returns decrypted data requires admin role
Non-admin users receive 403 Forbidden
API key auth continues to pass (service-to-service)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Sanitize error responses across all routers
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need all detail=str(e) patterns replaced with generic error messages. Currently 8 endpoints leak internal exception details (table names, file paths, stack traces) to API callers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a safe_error_response utility in orchestrator/core/utils/ that logs full exception server-side and returns generic message to client
Fix orchestrator/api/document_generation.py lines 231, 321: replace detail=str(e) with safe generic message
Fix orchestrator/api/cloud_documents.py line 420: replace detail=str(e)
Fix orchestrator/api/routing.py lines 496, 541: replace detail=str(e)
Fix orchestrator/api/admin_plugins.py line 193: replace detail=str(e)
Grep confirms zero remaining detail=str(e) patterns across orchestrator/api/
Internal details (table names, file paths, stack traces) never appear in HTTP response bodies
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update outdated dependencies with known CVEs
userStories.description: As a platform operator, I need dependencies updated to address known CVEs. FastAPI is 0.104.1 (Nov 2023), uvicorn 0.24.0, python-jose is unmaintained (PyJWT already used instead), and passlib is unmaintained.
acceptanceCriteria: Update fastapi from 0.104.1 to latest stable (0.115+) in orchestrator/requirements.txt
Update uvicorn[standard] from 0.24.0 to latest stable
Update python-multipart from 0.0.6 to latest stable
Remove python-jose[cryptography] from requirements (unused, PyJWT is the active JWT library)
Update scikit-learn from 1.3.2 to latest stable
Update psutil from 5.9.6 to latest stable
Verify the application starts and key endpoints respond after all updates
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement functional audit service
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the audit service to actually log security-relevant events. Currently orchestrator/core/services/audit_service.py is a 199-byte stub with no implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement AuditService in orchestrator/core/services/audit_service.py with log_event(event_type, actor, resource, details) method
Log to structured JSON format via Python logging (audit-specific logger)
Capture at minimum: auth failures, permission changes, credential access, admin actions, system setting changes
Wire audit logging into the admin_prompts, system_settings, credentials, and permissions routers
Audit logs include timestamp, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, workspace_id, ip_address
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Enforce database connection SSL
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need database connections to enforce SSL/TLS in production. Currently sslmode is not specified in DATABASE_URL construction.
acceptanceCriteria: In orchestrator/core/database/database.py, append ?sslmode=require to DATABASE_URL when ENVIRONMENT is production
Development mode continues to work without SSL requirement
Connection to Railway PostgreSQL still works with SSL enforced
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add global request body size limit
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need a global request body size limit to prevent oversized payloads. Only document upload has a 50MB check; all other endpoints (chat, workflows, etc.) have no limit.
acceptanceCriteria: Add middleware or uvicorn configuration in orchestrator/main.py to limit request body to 10MB by default
Document upload endpoints explicitly override to allow up to 50MB
Requests exceeding the limit receive 413 Payload Too Large
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix remaining SQL f-string patterns
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the remaining f-string SQL patterns converted to parameterized queries. The SET LOCAL statement_timeout in database_knowledge.py line 574 uses f-string interpolation. While currently safe due to int coercion, it should use proper parameterization.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert orchestrator/api/database_knowledge.py line 574 SET LOCAL statement_timeout from f-string to parameterized form
Audit orchestrator/api/channels.py line 145 dynamic SQL UPDATE — ensure column names are validated against allowlist
Grep confirms zero f-string patterns within text() or execute() calls across orchestrator/
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Run dev Docker stage as non-root user
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the development Docker stage to run as a non-root user. The production stage correctly creates and uses the automatos user, but the development target in docker-compose.yml runs as root.
acceptanceCriteria: Add non-root user creation to the development stage in orchestrator/Dockerfile (or Dockerfile.backend)
docker-compose.yml development target runs as the non-root user
All file permissions work correctly for the development workflow
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Enable TypeScript strict build checking
userStories.description: As a developer, I need TypeScript build errors caught during build. If ignoreBuildErrors is set to true in next.config.js, type-safety issues can reach production.
acceptanceCriteria: Check frontend/next.config.js for ignoreBuildErrors setting
If ignoreBuildErrors is true, set it to false
Fix any TypeScript errors that surface from the change
Build completes successfully with next build
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Extract user_id from auth context instead of query params
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need user_id sourced from the authenticated context, not from client-provided query parameters. Accepting user_id from the client allows impersonation.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit all endpoints accepting user_id as query parameter or request body field
Replace client-provided user_id with ctx.user.id from RequestContext in credentials and permissions endpoints
Ensure no endpoint trusts client-supplied user_id for authorization decisions
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Remove hardcoded Docker Compose credential defaults
userStories.description: As a platform operator, I need docker-compose to require explicit credentials rather than falling back to hardcoded defaults that could reach production.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove default values from POSTGRES_PASSWORD, REDIS_PASSWORD, API_KEY in docker-compose.yml
Add or update .env.example with placeholder values and setup instructions
Docker compose fails with clear error if required vars are not set
Typecheck passes
